description: Turn left 90 degrees at the wall (wall_turn, turn_sign +1 = left/CCW, the same move the M05 turn-left-at-the-wall plans use), then approach the nearest confirmed potted plant and stop at its default gap. The request said 'potted person'; no such class exists, so this reads it as potted plant. The plant must be in view after the turn: acquire_timeout_sec 5 starts when the second move starts. Needs semantic_layer_node (/costmap/semantic_tracks) and the global EKF.
